title: HalluRNN: Mitigating Hallucinations via Recurrent Cross-Layer Reasoning in Large Vision-Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical mitigation of hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models using a recurrent architecture. It evaluates the model on standard vision-language benchmarks for accuracy and grounding. There is no component related to religion, faith, theology, or ethical/moral benchmarking beyond a standard broader impact statement.
